name: 17527 · Gap, PA
findings: ZIP 17527 (Gap) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (78% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17527 (Gap) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
